# Monily

> Monily is a comprehensive financial accounting platform offering bookkeeping, tax preparation, CFO services, and industry-specific accounting solutions for small businesses, startups, and specialized sectors.

Monily provides expert accounting and bookkeeping services across multiple industries including ecommerce, real estate, healthcare, law, restaurants, and startups. The platform integrates with leading accounting software like QuickBooks, NetSuite, Xero, and industry-specific tools to deliver scalable financial management solutions.

- [Tax Preparation Services | Thorough & Efficient Filing](https://monily.com/services/tax-preparation): Tax preparation services including individual and business taxes with IRS compliance
- [1099 Filing Services | Precise & Timely Compliance](https://monily.com/services/1099-tax-filing): 1099 tax filing and compliance services for freelancers and contractors
- [Fractional CFO Services | Hire Expert Financial Guidance](https://monily.com/services/fractional-cfo): Fractional CFO services providing financial strategy and cash flow management guidance
- [Hire a Bookkeeper | Expert Financial Management Services](https://monily.com/services/bookkeeper-on-demand): On-demand bookkeeper hiring service starting at $15/hour for flexible financial management
